description: Developer-facing UI where technical terms are legitimate and protocol semantics must remain exact.

cases.context: Webhook 投递详情。最近一次请求返回 HTTP 401，系统不会自动重试；用户可以查看请求日志，但不能从当前页重发。

inputCopy.text: delivery worker 收到 401，进入 no-retry branch。

verifiedFacts: 最近一次 webhook 请求返回 HTTP 401
系统不会自动重试这次投递
用户可以查看该请求的日志
mustPreservePropositions: 保留 webhook、HTTP 401 和不会自动重试这些技术事实
唯一动作是查看请求日志
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露 worker、branch 或数据库备注等实现结构
使用没有对象的继续处理按钮
mustNotInfer: 签名密钥错误是 401 的确定原因
当前页可以重发、修复或测试 webhook
layoutConstraints: HTTP 状态码必须可扫描
cases.rationale: 面向开发者的自然语言应删除实现噪声，而不是删除 API、webhook 或 HTTP 语义。

cases.context: An API token detail panel. Revoking the token immediately rejects future requests using it. Existing logs remain. Revoke and Cancel are the only controls.

inputCopy.text: This operation cleans up the credential lifecycle and cannot be rolled back.

verifiedFacts: Revocation immediately rejects future API requests using this token
mustPreservePropositions: Identify the object as an API token
Future requests using the token are rejected immediately
mustRemoveIntents: Describe the action as a mutation or lifecycle cleanup
mustNotInfer: Existing logs or historical requests are deleted
A replacement token is created automatically
layoutConstraints: The destructive button names both action and object
The irreversible warning remains visible in the dialog
cases.rationale: The rewrite must clarify a security-sensitive action while preserving API terminology and exact effects.
